label: spokesperson for
definition: Person X is spokesperson for organization, office or person Y.
scope_notes: Preserves spokesperson/speak-for role. Different professional roles and geographical association alone do not establish it.

facts.reason: Borakove is explicitly spokeswoman/spokesman for Medical Examiner and its office.
Steets is explicitly Entergy spokesman; manager is separate evidence.
Serbs are in, flee or are driven from Croatia; they are not its spokesperson in these rows.
Abrams is explicitly spokeswoman for Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
Nielsen is explicitly spokeswoman/spokesman for The Times.
